name: Vivian Maier – Antologia
description: Explore over 140 photographs by the renowned street photographer Vivian Maier, a captivating collection at the Centro Português de Fotografia.
longDescription:
"Vivian Maier – Antologia" presents an extensive exhibition of over 140 photographic works by the American street photographer Vivian Maier. Hosted at the Centro Português de Fotografia, this collection offers an in-depth look at Maier's distinctive approach to capturing everyday life and candid moments, primarily in Chicago and New York, during the mid-20th century. The exhibition aims to showcase the breadth of her largely undiscovered archive, bringing her unique perspective to a wider audience.

Visitors to the Centro Português de Fotografia can expect to spend approximately one to two hours exploring the exhibition. The venue, a historic building that once served as a prison, provides a distinctive backdrop for the display of Maier's work. The exhibition is suitable for individuals interested in photography, art history, and social documentation. Information accompanying the photographs is presented in Portuguese and English.

The exhibition runs from April 16, 2026, to August 30, 2026. Tickets are available for purchase at the venue. The Centro Português de Fotografia is located in the city center, within walking distance of the São Bento train station and the Aliados metro station. It is also accessible via several bus routes.
